test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Sword’ is related to ‘Weapon’ in the same way as ‘Necklace’ is related to ‘______’.
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Sword is one of the equipment of weapon.

Similarly,

Necklace is one of the item in Jewellery.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Jewellery".**
